comment: The pitch output is quantized to the nearest of seventy-two named scale frequencies rather than carrying the raw bin frequency (FlowerPatch.cpp:311), and the reference used is 0.75V for 440Hz, which is the standard volt-per-octave reference. The hue, fill and flower CVs are read inside the drawing code rather than in process(), so they change what is drawn but nothing that comes out of the jacks.
